snp2.7:3.4: According to SnA, ‘Brahmā treasure’ refers to such mind states as the development of goodwill. See Sn 1:8, note 1.
snp2.7:6.2: ‘Protecting their principles, protected by law’: two possible meanings of dhamma-rakkhitā. SnA explains this term with reference to the Dhamma passage, ‘The Dhamma protects those who live by the Dhamma.’ (Thag 4:10)
snp2.7:8.1: I.e., in choosing their wives. See AN 5:191.
snp2.7:21.4: Three types of sacrifice defined by details in the equipment used.
snp2.7:23.2: Reading sabbaso with the Thai edition. The other editions read bhāgaso, ‘laid out.’
snp2.7:34.4: See also: MN 60; MN 93; SN 3:9; AN 5:191.
